scope: Fish browser rerun origin plus one bounded Car R127 recovery-packaging recurrence; global=false
problem: A successful historical run or a package whose files pass hashes can still be non-rerunnable when the verifier depends on unrecorded toolchains, ambient host paths, or static absolute imports. A content-addressed mount map verifies supplied bytes but does not by itself redirect source code that never consumes the map.
falsifiableHypothesis: A Car R127 verifier whose command, working directory and all source references are relative to one content-addressed logical input root will rerun in an empty directory and fail closed for a missing predecessor, changed source byte or changed verifier dependency. A mount map added without removing or explicitly loading static host-absolute imports will still fail before the mapped input can be used.

Remove the relative-root candidate wrapper; do not reactivate geometry or weaken existing gates.

teacher.name: Bazel Remote Execution API v2.3 input-root model
teacher.specificNovelty: Bind the command and a content-addressed input-root Directory into one Action identity; materialize the exact tree before execution; require the working directory and outputs to be relative to that root.
teacher.boundary: REAPI explicitly leaves default environment, host filesystems and some path resolution to implementations; it can allow absolute command paths or absolute symlink targets. It is an action-identity and input-namespace teacher, not proof of sandbox hermeticity and not a reason to deploy a remote executor.
